content_sections.heading: DME Tripura Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 7 vacancies are available - 1 each for Professor (Rachana Sharir), Professor (Kriya Sharir), Professor (Samhita Siddhanta), Assistant Professor (Kriya Sharir), Assistant Professor (Shalakya Tantra (Netra)), Consultant (Teacher of Clinical Subject) (Shalakya Tantra [Mukha, Nashika, Karna (ENT)]), and Consultant (Teacher of Clinical Subject) (Prasuti Tantra evam Stri Rog).

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DME Tripura Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DME Tripura recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the DME Tripura recruitment is scheduled to be held on 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Professor, Assistant Professor, and Consultant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced by the Directorate of Medical Education for Professor, Assistant Professor, and Consultant positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for DME Tripura recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) to apply for the DME Tripura recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions at DME Tripura will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the DME Tripura office in Udaipur, Tripura. Specific venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contractual positions at the Directorate of Medical Education, Tripura.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation provided for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of the Directorate of Medical Education, Tripura?
faq.answer: The official website of the Directorate of Medical Education, Tripura is https://dme.tripura.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is F. A-12/0012/2026-TRAINING&EDU-DME.
